simple.summary: רֶטֶט (reṭeṭ) means terror First listed occurrence: Jer 49 24.

definitions.full: H7374. retet רֶ֫טֶט noun [masculine] trembling, panic (Ba NB § 20 a Kö ii. 1, 42 ); — absolute ׳ר הֶהֱזִיקָה Jer 49:24 she hath seized panic , but < הֶחֱזִיקָהּ (Gie), panic hath seized her.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to tremble ;
